name: Bo Zhao
notes: Source: personal site only (no abstracts; Boston Fed profile and CV not fetched). Excluded policy briefs, NEPPC research reports, regional briefs, an ebook chapter and unlisted submitted items. Working papers that the site shows later published were dropped (Rainy Day, Walking a Tightrope, Urban Core, Cost Function, Education Aid Formula, Municipal Aid Evaluation, Designing State Aid Formulas, Measuring Disparities, Local-option taxes, 2015 PFR paper). The 2017 "Transparency in State Debt Disclosure" WP was treated as the earlier version of the R&R "Salience and Political Economy of State Debt Reporting" (same coauthor; title differs, not confirmed). Years for R&R papers taken from the FRB Boston WP year; JFQA item is listed as "Reject and Resubmit". "Designing Formulas for Distributing Reductions in State Aid" (2011 NEPPC WP) may be the earlier version of "A More Equitable Approach..." (PFR 2015) but this was not confirmed, so kept. Coauthor first names filled from memory for Coyne, Bradbury, Blanchard, Yinger, Ondrich, Jackson, Triest; Wang, Sasser, Saas, Luengo-Prado given as surname only because the page gives only surnames.
